notes.zh-CN: 桌面输入框新增「转为英文」按钮，点击后将草稿翻译成英文并回填，确认后再发送。支持取消、重试、恢复原文和撤销/重做；继续输入、切换会话或发送时会取消翻译，丢弃过期结果。原有「优化」按钮保持可用。macOS 为 universal 开发签名，未公证。Windows 安装包未签名。Android APK 为调试签名。iOS IPA 为开发签名，仅供团队已注册设备安装。
notes.en: The desktop composer now has a “To English” button that translates your draft in place for review before sending. Supports cancel, retry, restore original, and undo/redo. Typing, switching conversations, or sending cancels translation and discards stale results. The existing Optimize button remains available. The universal macOS app is development-signed and unnotarized. Windows installers are unsigned. The Android APK is debug-signed. The development-signed iOS IPA installs on registered team devices.
